dz: 第一次普尼奇战争:埃盖特人之战:罗马人击沉了使第一次普尼奇战争结束的迦太基分舰队.
de: First Punic War: Battle of the Aegates: The Romans sink the Carthaginian fleet bringing the First Punic War to an end.
